message.content: Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city. They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family. They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff. Pebble Spring entered the old district. The cobbles hummed under her feet. The bridges gleamed with rain. The houses leaned like friendly trees. She studied every stone. She sketched each doorway. She traced roof lines in the air. Her staff released tiny sparks. The sparks outlined a wall. The clay settled with a soft sigh. The beams clicked into place. The roof rose in a gentle curve. The door bowed just a little. Neighbors gathered to watch. The children waved at the little house. The Leshy felt a warm glow. The city felt closer to her roots. The earth felt more like home. Pebble Spring wanted to build again. Although the ancient Leshy Pebble Spring had admired every polished bridge, every bright street, every neat roof, and every careful wall, yet she still loved the strange, uneven, and quietly stained old earth beneath spotty patterns.
